name: Mouth
overview: Scripture emphasizes the power and responsibility of the mouth, urging believers to guard their words carefully. Psalms 141:3 calls for God’s protection over our speech, while Proverbs highlights the wisdom of restraining the lips to avoid sin and destruction. Jeremiah 1:9 reveals that God places His words in the mouths of His servants, underscoring the sacredness of what we confess and speak. Together, these verses teach that our mouth can either bring life and healing or cause harm, making it essential to speak with wisdom and divine guidance.
